name: Phantom Needle
flavor: There's no blade in your hand. That doesn't stop the audience member three rows back clutching their arm.
description: You point at a creature you can see within range, and for one vivid instant it feels exactly what a blade sliding between its ribs would feel like. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}} or take [[1d8]] psychic damage, flinching from a wound that was never there. On a success, the target takes no damage.
narration: There is no blade in your hand. You point anyway, and somewhere three rows back a body doubles over clutching a rib that has not been touched, entirely convinced.
sheetSummary: Wisdom save vs {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}. Fail: [[1d8]] psychic damage. Success: no effect.
